http-functions.name: Wix HTTP Functions (Gateway)
http-functions.description: Central API gateway ΓÇö 50+ endpoints for registration, pipeline, payments, CRM, admin, member portal, email.

email-reader.name: Email Reader Agent
email-reader.description: 6-phase email processing pipeline polled every 5 minutes via GitHub Actions scheduler.

user-query-agent.name: Classifier Agent (User Query)
user-query-agent.description: Classifies incoming emails into 10+ categories. Generates context-aware responses. ApprovalWorkflow for president-level queries.

rl-engine.name: RL Feedback Engine
rl-engine.description: Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit with UCB1 exploration. 4 actions: DO_NOTHING, NOTIFY_PRESIDENT, ACK_ONLY, FULL_RESPONSE.

event-manager.name: Event Manager Agent
event-manager.description: YAML-driven drive lifecycle controller. Manages 11 drives (ALWAYS_ON, EVENT_BOUND, TRIGGERED) across 11 events.

change-agent.name: Change Agent
change-agent.description: Technical validation of change requests. Module risk analysis, stakeholder routing, auto-ticket creation.

design-arch-agent.name: Design-Architecture Agent
design-arch-agent.description: Maintains live architecture document. Records ADRs, tracks module inventory, generates architecture views.

message-queue.name: Message Queue Processor
message-queue.description: File-backed FIFO queue with dedup, DLQ, retry/backoff. Routes email messages to pipeline phases.

memory-rag.name: Agent Memory RAG
memory-rag.description: Vector-based knowledge store for long-term agent learning. TF-IDF similarity search, dedup on store.

compliance.name: Communication Compliance
compliance.description: Email header encoding (RFC 2047), content validation, PII redaction, audit trail.

payment-engine.name: Payment Purpose Engine
payment-engine.description: Classifies Zelle payments by purpose (membership, event, donation). Generates acknowledgment emails.

delivery-agent.name: Delivery Failure Agent
delivery-agent.description: Detects bounced emails, attempts spouse recovery from CRM, escalates unrecoverable to admin.

admin-portal.name: Admin Portal
admin-portal.description: Super Admin dashboard ΓÇö EC onboarding, dev board, feedback pipeline, agent monitoring, drive management.

member-portal.name: Member Portal
member-portal.description: Member self-service ΓÇö profile, family, events, payments, QR code access.

banf-drives-yaml.name: Drive Configuration (YAML)
banf-drives-yaml.description: Central YAML config for all 11 pipeline drives and 11 events. Defines activation rules, handlers, gmail queries.

crm.name: CRM Data (Reconciliation)
crm.description: 235 members with full profiles, family links, contact info. Source of truth for member data.

decisions.title: Use Contextual MAB (UCB1) for email action selection
decisions.context: Email classifier was approving spam for president review, wasting time
decisions.decision: Implement Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit with UCB1 exploration instead of rule-based filtering
decisions.rationale: UCB1 balances exploration/exploitation naturally. No external ML infrastructure needed. Learns from rejection feedback.

decisions.title: File-backed message queue over managed service
decisions.context: Need message queue for email pipeline but Wix has no server access
decisions.decision: Use better-queue pattern with JSON file persistence (Phase 1), migrate to BullMQ + Upstash Redis when volume demands it (Phase 2)
decisions.rationale: Zero external dependencies for Phase 1. $0 cost. Wix constraints prevent Kafka/RabbitMQ. Upstash free tier (10K cmd/day) covers future needs.

decisions.title: YAML-driven drive lifecycle over hardcoded config
decisions.context: Drive activation was scattered across code, no central config
decisions.decision: Move all drive definitions to banf-drives.yaml with Event Manager Agent owning lifecycle state
decisions.rationale: Declarative config separates what from when. Non-developers can understand drive definitions. Agent manages state transitions.

decisions.title: Change Agent + Design-Architecture Agent for governance
decisions.context: Dev board had only mock data, no real change tracking or architecture documentation
decisions.decision: Create Change Agent for technical review/approval and Design-Architecture Agent for doc maintenance
decisions.rationale: Formalizes software engineering process. Stakeholder approval pipeline toggleable by super admin. Auto-generates architecture doc.

decisions.title: Message queue integrated into email reader pipeline
decisions.context: Each scan phase enqueues emails, ack on success, nack to DLQ on failure
decisions.decision: Wrap existing scan/process handlers with MQ enqueue/ack/nack. Non-invasive integration preserving current flow.
